basis: Vision inspection of actual source poster, offline mobile closed and desktop open screenshots; not user approval or photoreal equivalence.
final_mobile: Higher default camera makes all five domes separately identifiable: three rear, two front. Full chest and controls remain visible.
initial_failure: Default inherited low camera merged/occluded one dome at mobile size. initial/mobile-four-visible.png retains the rejected presentation.
fix: Changed only viewer camera from (-5,3.7,7) to (-4,5.8,7), rebuilt and reran complete offline browser and extended checks.
source_render: Five domes present; source-rendered poster, not generated promotional art.
limitations: Stylized simplified dome geometry, not a geographic reconstruction
Regular strong bands can read as painted wood in the source render; browser reads more like banded sandstone
Pronounced dark seam and blocky fittings are family-design abstractions
Some dome contours overlap in projection, though all five are now countable
Mobile is desktop-GPU touch emulation, not a physical phone
Front open view naturally hides lid-top domes; rear-open view is included
brief_deviation: Foreground dome footprint reaches y=-0.69545 rather than nominal -0.65. Kept for front-row separation; inside the lid and included in clearance tests. Source acceptance bounds explicitly allow -0.75.
